decisions: Default local catalog path is apps/scene-engine/workspace.catalog.json; SCENE_ENGINE_WORKSPACE_CATALOG can override it.
The committed catalog example points to ../../../codecaine-site from apps/scene-engine.
Codecaine was migrated with a copy-first strategy into ../codecaine-site; app-local projects/public files remain as documented legacy fallback/source comparison data, not active authoring inputs.
Project registries retain logical /assets, /modules, and /fonts paths; dev serving resolves those through /api/projects/<projectId> routes and exports resolve them through MELEE_BUNDLE_ROOT.
V1 engine built-ins remain renderer/editor primitives. Codecaine CRT, main menu, media, fonts, and project modules live in the Codecaine workspace.

logical module URLs rewritten to project dev routes
title/menu render and title click navigates to menu
remaining app code hits classified as export or legacy fallback; stale doc hits 0

unresolved: Legacy app-local Codecaine duplicates remain intentionally as documented fallback/source comparison data. Removing them should be a separate cleanup after stakeholders no longer need fallback.
